title: What the Red Panda means

is_this_you.pressure: Under strain you smile at both sides and pick neither. Then, alone after midnight, you decide, and by breakfast it is settled.
is_this_you.love: You court so beautifully that some seasons you cannot tell whether you love the person or the courting.
is_this_you.cost: You leave a cracked thing alone for years, because mending it might chip the vase beside it.

opener.text: In Bumthang and Sengor, in Bhutan, Buddhist villagers told researchers that the red panda is a monk reborn, and its red coat is his robe [s7]. To see one is a good omen [s7]. People are glad when they glimpse you. Few of them ever see you close.

howto: Three parts on one branch. Read them in order, or out of it.

tabs.label: The balance
tabs.intro: Air on one side, Water on the other.

rows.text: Libra is cardinal Air, ruled by Venus [s1]. The Rat is yang Water, first of the twelve [s3]. Libra opens at the September equinox, when day and night stand level [s1]. The Rat rules the midnight hour, when one day hands over to the next [s3]. Both your signs stand on a hinge. By day you keep the scales level, and by night you weigh what was on them.

rows.k: The red panda does it too
rows.text: The red panda is most active at dusk and at dawn [s10]. It keeps the hours between. So do you. Your best thinking comes while the house sleeps, and your best charm comes once it wakes.

Libra is gracious and fair, and slow to press its own case [s2]. The Rat is quick and resourceful, with a nose for an opening [s4]. Outside you are all courtesy. Inside you have already run the numbers.

tabs.label: Your branch
tabs.intro: What you keep, and what you spend.

rows.text: The Libra guides list judge and mediator [s2]. The Rat guides list researcher and writer [s4]. Pick work where both sides must trust you, or work you build alone and show finished. Mediation suits one half of you. Curating suits the other.

In Japan, rats belong to Daikokuten, the god of wealth, and the Days of the Rat are sacred to him [s15]. The Rat is tied to thrift [s4]. Libra is drawn to fine things [s2]. Keep one fund that nobody sees. Buy one object that everybody notices.
The Rat makes friends easily and seldom deepens them [s4]. Libra can turn cool and detached [s2]. Together that makes a lovely branch with no way up to it.

tabs.label: Who shares your branch
tabs.intro: Three who climb up easily. One who shakes the tree.
tabs.love_lead: In love you want grace on the outside and patience underneath. The one who wins you keeps knocking, gently, until you open. The old pairings name three who will.

easy.why: The Raven (Aquarius, Monkey year) shares your trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey, and Aquarius is Air like Libra [s5] [s1].
The Three-wattled Bellbird (Gemini, Ox year) is your secret friend, since the Ox is the Rat's hidden ally and carried it through the Great Race [s5] [s3].
The Superb Lyrebird (Gemini, Dragon year) closes the trine, and Gemini brings the third Air sign to your table [s5] [s1].

hard.why: The Green Sea Turtle (Cancer, Horse year) is the hard one, because the Horse clashes with the Rat across the wheel [s5].

story.text: In Chinese the red panda is 小熊猫 (xiǎo xióngmāo), the little bear-cat [s11]. It is also 火狐 (huǒhú), the fire fox [s11] [s8]. And it is 九节狼 (jiǔjié láng), the nine-section wolf, for the rings along its tail [s11] [s6].

closing: May the ones who glimpse you call it luck. May the one who climbs up to you stay.
